en.text: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

zhSimplified.text: 我儿，你要遵守我的言语， 将我的命令存记在心。

zhTraditional.text: 我兒，你要遵守我的言語， 將我的命令存記在心。

en.text: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

zhSimplified.text: 遵守我的命令就得存活； 保守我的法则， 好像保守眼中的瞳人，

zhTraditional.text: 遵守我的命令就得存活； 保守我的法則， 好像保守眼中的瞳人，

en.text: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

zhSimplified.text: 系在你指头上， 刻在你心版上。

zhTraditional.text: 繫在你指頭上， 刻在你心版上。

en.text: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

zhSimplified.text: 对智慧说：你是我的姊妹， 称呼聪明为你的亲人，

zhTraditional.text: 對智慧說：你是我的姊妹， 稱呼聰明為你的親人，

en.text: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

zhSimplified.text: 她就保你远离淫妇， 远离说谄媚话的外女。

zhTraditional.text: 她就保你遠離淫婦， 遠離說諂媚話的外女。

en.text: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

zhSimplified.text: 我曾在我房屋的窗户内， 从我窗棂之间往外观看：

zhTraditional.text: 我曾在我房屋的窗戶內， 從我窗欞之間往外觀看：

en.text: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

zhSimplified.text: 见愚蒙人内，少年人中， 分明有一个无知的少年人，

zhTraditional.text: 見愚蒙人內，少年人中， 分明有一個無知的少年人，

en.text: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

zhSimplified.text: 从街上经过，走近淫妇的巷口， 直往通她家的路去，

zhTraditional.text: 從街上經過，走近淫婦的巷口， 直往通她家的路去，

en.text: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

zhSimplified.text: 在黄昏，或晚上， 或半夜，或黑暗之中。

zhTraditional.text: 在黃昏，或晚上， 或半夜，或黑暗之中。

en.text: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，有一个妇人来迎接他， 是妓女的打扮，有诡诈的心思。

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，有一個婦人來迎接他， 是妓女的打扮，有詭詐的心思。

en.text: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

zhSimplified.text: 这妇人喧嚷，不守约束， 在家里停不住脚，

zhTraditional.text: 這婦人喧嚷，不守約束， 在家裏停不住腳，

en.text: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

zhSimplified.text: 有时在街市上，有时在宽阔处， 或在各巷口蹲伏，

zhTraditional.text: 有時在街市上，有時在寬闊處， 或在各巷口蹲伏，

en.text: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

zhSimplified.text: 拉住那少年人，与他亲嘴， 脸无羞耻对他说：

zhTraditional.text: 拉住那少年人，與他親嘴， 臉無羞恥對他說：

en.text: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

zhSimplified.text: 平安祭在我这里， 今日才还了我所许的愿。

zhTraditional.text: 平安祭在我這裏， 今日才還了我所許的願。

en.text: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

zhSimplified.text: 因此，我出来迎接你， 恳切求见你的面，恰巧遇见了你。

zhTraditional.text: 因此，我出來迎接你， 懇切求見你的面，恰巧遇見了你。

en.text: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 我已经用绣花毯子 和埃及线织的花纹布铺了我的床。

zhTraditional.text: 我已經用繡花毯子 和埃及線織的花紋布鋪了我的床。

en.text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

zhSimplified.text: 我又用没药、沉香、桂皮 薰了我的榻。

zhTraditional.text: 我又用沒藥、沉香、桂皮 薰了我的榻。

en.text: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

zhSimplified.text: 你来，我们可以饱享爱情，直到早晨； 我们可以彼此亲爱欢乐。

zhTraditional.text: 你來，我們可以飽享愛情，直到早晨； 我們可以彼此親愛歡樂。

en.text: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我丈夫不在家，出门行远路；

zhTraditional.text: 因為我丈夫不在家，出門行遠路；

en.text: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

zhSimplified.text: 他手拿银囊，必到月望才回家。

zhTraditional.text: 他手拿銀囊，必到月望才回家。

en.text: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

zhSimplified.text: 淫妇用许多巧言诱他随从， 用谄媚的嘴逼他同行。

zhTraditional.text: 淫婦用許多巧言誘他隨從， 用諂媚的嘴逼他同行。

en.text: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

zhSimplified.text: 少年人立刻跟随她，好像牛往宰杀之地； 又像愚昧人带锁链去受刑罚，

zhTraditional.text: 少年人立刻跟隨她，好像牛往宰殺之地； 又像愚昧人帶鎖鍊去受刑罰，

en.text: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

zhSimplified.text: 直等箭穿他的肝； 如同雀鸟急入网罗，却不知是自丧己命。

zhTraditional.text: 直等箭穿他的肝； 如同雀鳥急入網羅，卻不知是自喪己命。

en.text: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 众子啊，现在要听从我， 留心听我口中的话。

zhTraditional.text: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我， 留心聽我口中的話。

en.text: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

zhSimplified.text: 你的心不可偏向淫妇的道， 不要入她的迷途。

zhTraditional.text: 你的心不可偏向淫婦的道， 不要入她的迷途。

en.text: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，被她伤害仆倒的不少； 被她杀戮的而且甚多。

zhTraditional.text: 因為，被她傷害仆倒的不少； 被她殺戮的而且甚多。

en.text: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

footnotes.text: 7:27 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 她的家是在阴间之路， 下到死亡之宫。

zhTraditional.text: 她的家是在陰間之路， 下到死亡之宮。
